entry.title: Israel's opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot has six weeks to form a government
entry.summary: In Israel, a candidate tasked with forming a new government has 28 days to carry out the job. The president is able to extend this by a maximum of 14 days before giving the mandate to someone else.
entry.content:
